T. Delling Construction is an owner-led general contracting firm focused on commercial construction, including office buildings and churches, with select residential projects.

A focused approach to substantial projects
Our approach

Direct involvement.
Lasting relationships.

We believe successful construction is built on experienced leadership, careful coordination, and trust. By intentionally maintaining a focused operation, we keep ownership closely involved in the projects we undertake.

We work directly with property owners, providing personal attention, responsive communication, and hands-on project oversight from planning through completion.

Our longstanding relationships with architects, engineers, subcontractors, and other construction professionals allow us to bring together the right expertise for each project.

Our work is predominantly commercial, with experience in office buildings and church facilities. We also undertake select residential construction projects.

We value enduring professional relationships and take pride in being accountable to the owners and communities we serve.
